title: Where The Bears Are
overview: In this uproarious and suspenseful feature-length cut of the acclaimed web series, Where the Bears Are follows three gay bear roommates living in Los Angeles whose lives are turned upside down when a party guest is found dead in their bathtub. What begins as a wild weekend spirals into a hilarious yet gripping whodunit, as the trio balances dating, friendships, and their quest for justice — all while navigating the bear subculture and their own eccentricities.
